in_marathi.name: Vora

in_marathi.long_meaning: Vora हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vora is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vrtra', which refers to a serpent demon that was slain by Indra, the god of thunder and rain.
